tasks.title: babysit skill
tasks.description: One-pass shepherd: read pr-status per open PR, take the single correct action (re-trigger CR / fix-ci / coderabbit-pr-review / report ready), summarize, suggest re-run cadence.
acceptance: Describes one-pass model + action decision table
Re-triggers CR only when rateLimit.limited was true and resetsAt has passed
Invokes fix-ci on red CI and coderabbit-pr-review on unresolved threads
Never sleeps in-session; reports actions + suggested cadence
